rulings.why: p643-strip0.jpg system 1, row 1: 'Love' is capitalised in 'O per-fect Love,' as a name of God addressed (stanza 2 prints 'Life' the same way, beside 'Thou'). The header's metre 11.10.11.10 counts the whole row, from 'O' to 'tran-scend-ing', as one 11-syllable line, so the capital opens no poem line.
